svg.title: Substack — flat mark
svg.desc: Substack mark as a solid, cel-shaded emblem with an unchanged source silhouette. Simple Icons 16.30.0; CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Original front path preserved. Illustrated version adds cel-shaded extrusion; flat version is scaled and centered. Colors use the repository palette.
